selection_policy.purpose: Purposive writing corpus, not an objectively unique top-35 ranking or an inference about acceptance preferences.
selection_axes: verified full conference proceedings identity and track
official Test of Time recognition where available
documented continued use or technical influence
topic, period, contribution and author-group coverage
selection_policy.calibration: Two separately identified 2025 main-track papers from the latest completed annual meeting; recent calibration is not Test of Time recognition.
selection_policy.reading: Read means full main-text narrative, figures and captions read from the actual retrieved version; relevant appendices when stated. It does not mean line-by-line proof verification or reproduction.
selection_policy.deduplication: Canonical neurips:year:officialhash; DOI and arXiv versions are aliases and never extra counts.
